games.name: 👑 Rise To Royalty
games.desc:
🌾 Begin your journey as a humble Peasant, work to earn Silver, provide for yourself, and carve out your place within the Kingdom.

⚒️ Take on occupations across the realm, build your wealth, and unlock new roles as you climb the social hierarchy.

⚔️ Progress through 10 unique roles, from Peasant to Monarch, each unlocking new responsibilities and opportunities.

👑 Earn the Monarch's trust through loyalty and service... or gather influence, seize the throne, and rule the realm yourself.

🔥 Govern wisely, for a neglected Kingdom may revolt against your reign and claim the Crown for another.

─────────「🏰」─────────

⚠️・Rise To Royalty is currently in Open Beta. Expect bugs, glitches, balance changes, and unfinished content as we continue expanding the Kingdom with regular updates.

📜・This game is a fantasy experience and is not intended to be historically accurate.

games.name: Overfarmed! [Factories]
games.desc:
☢ UPDATE 1.6.2
- Nuclear energy has been added: enrich uranium and generate large power.
- The Harvest Festival event has arrived! Build a festival and increase your rating.
- Revamped oil system, now needs to be distilled before being turned into products.
- Game/crop rebalances.
- Much more!

Farm and expand your fields to earn the most money!

- 🌾 Unlock or forage for new crops!
- 🧑‍🌾 Upgrade and automate equipment!
- 🎣 Go fishing for unique catches!
- 🐦‍⬛ Defend your farm against crows!
- 🏭 Use your crops to manufacture goods!

PC Controls:
Ctrl - Toggle Sprint
B/X - Open Place/Delete mode
G/E - Sell/Replant Highlighted Item
R/F - Water/Fertilize Crop
P - Plant Last Crop on All Tiles
L - Sell All Crops

👥 Play with friends with private servers or by sharing your server code!

Join the community: https://www.roblox.com/communities/34633422/Lumidex#!/about
Report bugs/issues through the Feedback menu in settings.
